crossRefs.note: I have set Yahweh always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.
Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and…
Yahweh, you have searched me, and you know me.
If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.
When Abram was ninety-nine years old, Yahweh appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and…
“Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel;” which is…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
For I, Yahweh your God, will hold your right hand, saying to you, ‘Don’t be afraid. I will help you.’
“Behold, my servant, whom I uphold, my chosen, in whom my soul delights: I have put my Spirit on him. He will bring…

translations.web: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.
translations.bsb: Yet I am always with You; You hold my right hand.
translations.kjv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: thou hast holden me by my right hand.
translations.asv: Nevertheless I am continually with thee: Thou hast holden my right hand.
